common.notConnectedDesc: Sign in to sync your characters and campaigns on your personal Google Drive.

hub.subtitle: Serverless Offline-First Architecture • SQLite Wasm • P2P WebRTC • Google Drive
hub.heroDesc: Connect your Google Drive from the top-right user menu to sync your characters and campaigns in the cloud, or work locally offline.
hub.pcDesc: Create or import your characters from Fight Club 5e XML, browse the offline compendium, shop during Downtime, and roll dice in real time with your party.
hub.pcBullet1: • Saved in your personal Google Drive (only the active PC stays in local cache)
hub.pcBullet2: • Free Garage Mode or bound to Campaign rules
hub.pcBullet3: • Responsive layout for smartphones, tablets, and desktops
hub.gmDesc: Create the campaign manifest, set max level and permissions, build the Downtime Shop from the SQLite database, and monitor party character sheets in real time.
hub.gmBullet1: • Automatic read-only sharing with players' Google emails
hub.gmBullet2: • Automatic audit of gold, level, and downtime purchases
hub.gmBullet3: • WebRTC P2P Host to receive dice rolls and push live updates
hub.footer: D&D 5e VTT — SQLite databases are cached locally in your browser for offline use.
